# Northwind Payroll

Northwind builds payroll and onboarding software for mid-market teams in the
United States. We serve finance and people operations leaders at companies with
between twenty and two hundred employees.

## What we do

Our platform runs payroll, manages contractor payments and keeps employment
records in one place. Customers move onto Northwind when spreadsheets and
email threads stop scaling with headcount.

## Who we serve

Business to business software companies, professional services firms and
healthcare groups. Most of our customers are hiring for the first time into
revenue operations and people operations roles.

## Company

Founded in 2021 and based in Austin, Texas. The team is forty two people.
Setup instructions are in our docs.
